1.consolidated_definition: Poco claro, nebuloso, indistinguible. Se dice de lo que no se distingue bien, que puede ser engañoso. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. En cine y cuando no hay foco se dice que esta blurry (FuzzyThings.com, consultado 15-09-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Unclear, nebulous, indistinguishable. Said of what is not well distinguished, which may be deceptive. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. In film and when there is no focus, it is said that this is blurry (FuzzyThings.com, consulted 15-09-08)
